jobs.title: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026: 1,356 Probationary Officer and Banking Associate Posts
jobs.summary: Jammu & Kashmir Bank has notified 323 Probationary Officer and 1,033 Banking Associate posts for graduates with UT of J&K domicile. Apply online by 26 November 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Graduate in any discipline, degree held by 26 Nov 2026; UT of J&K domicile only
Age: 20–30 years as on 01-01-2026 (relaxation SC/ST 5, OBC 3, PwBD 10 years)
Pay: PO starting basic Rs 48,480; Banking Associate starting basic Rs 24,050
Fee: PO Rs 1,200 + GST (Rs 1,000 + GST SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD); BA Rs 800 + GST (Rs 600 + GST SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM)
Selection: PO – Prelims, Mains + Descriptive, Interview; BA – online exam

jobs.title: APPSC Group-II 2026: 720 Executive and Non-Executive Posts
jobs.summary: APPSC has issued the detailed Group-II notification (No. 37/2026) for 720 posts including Deputy Tahsildar, Deputy MPDO, ASO, GST Officer and Accountants. Graduates can apply online by 11 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Bachelor's degree for most posts (subject-specific degree for ASO Finance/Law and Accountant posts)
Age: 18–44 for most posts as on 01-07-2026 (Excise SI 18–30)
Pay: Rs 25,220–80,910 up to Rs 45,830–1,30,580 depending on post
Fee: Rs 250 + Rs 80 exam fee (Rs 80 exempt for SC/ST/BC/PwBD/Ex-servicemen)
Selection: Screening test, Mains (2 papers), Computer Proficiency Test where applicable
Dates: apply 10 Nov – 11 Dec 2026; screening test 21 Feb 2027

jobs.title: DVC Executive Trainee 2026: 108 Posts through GATE 2025
jobs.summary: Damodar Valley Corporation is recruiting 108 Executive Trainees in Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, C&I and Mining on the basis of GATE 2025 scores. Apply online by 6 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Full-time B.E./B.Tech with 65% (60% SC/ST/PwD) and a valid GATE 2025 score in the matching paper
Age: Maximum 29 years (UR/EWS) as on 06-12-2026, relaxation as per rules
Selection: GATE 2025 marks, document verification, medical
